title: cyclobalanopsis lamellosa var. nigrinervis
intro: Cyclobalanopsis lamellosa var. nigrinervis, commonly known as black-barked oak, is a plant species within the Quercus genus, native to East Asia. The plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, including fever, cough, and digestive problems, due to its reported health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to reduce inflammation, calm the nervous system, and aid in the relief of respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of Cyclobalanopsis lamellosa var. nigrinervis include tannins, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
